description: Turn the KVM-over-IP console on or off for a dedicated server — the out-of-band console that works when the machine will not boot or the network is down, which makes it the thing to reach for BEFORE a reinstall. Once enabled, read the access details with `impreza_api_call` on /dedicated/{serviceId}/kvm and hand them to the account owner: treat them as a credential. Turn it off when the customer is done.

enable.description: true = enable the console; false = disable it.

name: impreza_dedicated_kvm
